title: Test your knowledge
intro: Six short questions covering the pillars, beliefs and seerah. Pick one answer per question and get instant feedback.

questions.q: How many pillars does Islam have?
questions.why: Five: the two testifications, prayer, alms-giving, fasting and the pilgrimage for those able.

questions.q: What is the condition without which the first testification is not valid?
questions.why: “There is no god but God” denies polytheism and affirms God’s oneness — the foundation of the religion.

questions.q: Which book is the primary source of Islamic law?
questions.why: The Qur’an, revealed to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, is the criterion against which other texts are measured.

questions.q: In which year was the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ born?
options: 570 CE — the Year of the Elephant
questions.why: He ﷺ was born around 570 CE in Mecca and died in 632 CE in Medina.

questions.q: What is the first thing a Muslim does upon entering a mosque?
options: Two rak‘ahs of greeting the mosque
questions.why: It is sunnah to pray two rak‘ahs of greeting the mosque before sitting or joining the prayer.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT encouraged by Islam?
questions.why: Cheating is condemned: “Whoever cheats is not one of us.”
